art_instructions: Show a sunny, bright scene from a slightly elevated viewpoint where a curved stone path leads from the village school on the left to a cozy cottage on the right. On the far left midground, place the school with white-washed stucco walls, Mediterranean blue wooden trim, terracotta roof tiles, a small porch with wooden columns, an olive tree, bougainvillea, and a small stone bird bath near the entrance. On the right midground, place the family house with creamy white walls, a warm terracotta roof, and sage-green shutters, with a small porch and a garden of sunflowers, lavender, and low berry bushes by a cobblestone gate. In the upper middle-right, position the Owl in midair, angled toward the house, wings outstretched mid-flap and tail slightly fanned; she should be about one quarter of the frame height. Show her mottled brown-and-cream feathers, round amber eyes, a small green scarf tied at her neck, and a tiny satchel slung across her chest with the strap fluttering behind. Give her a calm, happy, determined expression as she flies along the path’s curve toward home, with a few light motion strokes behind her wings to suggest gentle flight. Keep lighting bright with clear sunlight and soft shadows cast consistently to the lower right. Include a couple of tiny birds near the school eaves and butterflies over the house garden as background details, but keep the Owl the visual focus.
